warmup.detail: 5 min easy bike/walk. World's greatest stretch, glute bridge, 2 × 8 bodyweight squats, band pull-aparts.

main.detail: Goblet squat 3×8; RDL 3×8; push-up or DB press 3×8–10; DB row 3×10; farmer carry 3×40 m; side plank 3×30 s; calf raise 3×12. Rest ~90 s.

cooldown.detail: Easy walk 3 min. Stretch hip flexors, hamstrings. Foam roll glutes 2 min.

templates.title: Spine-safe strength
templates.summary: Unilateral lower body — spine as pillar protocol

warmup.detail: Easy walk 5 min. Cat-cow, bird dog 2 × 6, glute bridge 2 × 10.

main.detail: Split squat 3×8/side; glute bridge 3×10; push-up 3×8–10; single-arm row 3×10; suitcase carry 3×30 m; dead bug 3×8; bird dog 3×6/side; side plank 3×25 s. DO NOT: back squat, deadlift, crunch, sit-up, good morning, loaded twist.

cooldown.detail: Walk 3 min. 90/90 hips. Easy nasal breathing 1 min.

templates.title: Max strength — lower body
templates.summary: Neural strength — low reps, high load

warmup.detail: Easy bike 5 min. Hip openers. Ramp sets: empty bar → 50% → 70% working weight.

main.detail: Back squat or goblet squat 5×3–5; RDL 3×5; split squat 3×6/side. Rest 2–3 min between sets. Last rep leaves 1–2 in reserve.

cooldown.detail: Walk 5 min. Hip flexor and hamstring stretch.

templates.title: Hypertrophy circuit
templates.summary: Muscle endurance — 8–12 rep range for tissue capacity

warmup.detail: Easy walk 5 min. Dynamic warm-up. 2 × 15 bodyweight squats.

main.detail: Goblet squat 3×10; RDL 3×10; DB bench or push-up 3×10–12; lat pulldown or row 3×12; walking lunge 3×10/side; plank 3×45 s. Rest 60–90 s.

cooldown.detail: Walk 3 min. Stretch quads, pecs, lats.

templates.title: Power & plyometrics
templates.summary: Rate of force development — neuromuscular power

warmup.detail: Easy jog 5 min. A-skips, high knees, butt kicks. Activation: glute bridge, clamshell 2 × 12.

main.detail: Box jump or squat jump 4×5; med ball slam 4×6; kettlebell swing 3×8; push press 3×5; broad jump 4×3. Full rest between power sets (2 min). Quality over quantity.

cooldown.detail: Walk 5 min. Light stretch — no static hold on tired muscles before cooling.

templates.title: Strength endurance circuit
templates.summary: Muscular endurance — triathlon and OCR support

main.detail: 3 rounds: 12 goblet squat, 10 push-up, 10 DB row, 10 step-up, 30 s plank, 10 KB swing. 90 s between rounds. Move continuously within round.

cooldown.detail: Walk 5 min. Stretch hips and shoulders.

templates.title: Single-leg tri strength
templates.summary: Unilateral strength for triathletes — run off the bike durability

warmup.detail: Easy bike 5 min. Hip openers, glute activation.

main.detail: Bulgarian split squat 3×8/side; single-leg RDL 3×8/side; step-up 3×10/side; calf raise 3×15/side; side plank 3×30 s; dead bug 3×8. Rest 60 s.

templates.title: Upper push / pull
templates.summary: Upper-body balance — swim and posture support

warmup.detail: Band pull-aparts 2 × 15. Arm circles. Scapular push-ups 2 × 10.

main.detail: DB bench or push-up 3×8–10; DB row 3×10; overhead press 3×8; lat pulldown 3×10; face pull 3×15; tricep extension 2×12; bicep curl 2×12. Rest 60–90 s.

cooldown.detail: Doorway pec stretch, lat stretch. Band pull-aparts 2 × 15.

templates.title: Core & stability
templates.summary: Anti-rotation and bracing — spine health for endurance athletes

main.detail: Pallof press 3×10/side; dead bug 3×8; side plank 3×30 s/side; farmer carry 3×40 m; glute bridge 3×12; bird dog 3×8/side. No crunches or sit-ups.

cooldown.detail: Supine twist, 90/90 hips. Easy breathing 1 min.

templates.title: Hip prehab
templates.summary: Glute med and hip stability — runner's knee prevention

warmup.detail: Easy walk 4 min. Clamshell 2 × 12, glute bridge 2 × 10.

main.detail: Clamshell 3×15; banded lateral walk 3×12/side; single-leg glute bridge 3×10/side; monster walk 3×12; Copenhagen plank 3×20 s/side; step-down 3×8/side.

warmup.detail: Easy row 5 min. PVC pass-throughs, overhead squat with PVC, hip openers. Empty bar drills.

main.detail: Hang clean 5×3; front squat 3×5; push press 3×5; high pull 3×5. Focus on positions, not max load. Rest 2 min.

cooldown.detail: Walk 5 min. Wrist and hip flexor stretch.

templates.title: Strength deload
templates.summary: Reduced volume and intensity — supercompensation week

main.detail: Same movement patterns at 50–60% usual load: squat 2×8, RDL 2×8, push 2×10, pull 2×10, carry 2×30 m. Stop well before fatigue.
